 NEW Usman Nurmagomedov Reportedly Signs With UFC Ahead of UFC 334
 By Proma Chatterjee 
 Edited by Drew Zuhosky Nov 10, 2026 22 hours ago 1 min read Usman Nurmagomedov IMAGO/Anadolu Agency. Follow on Google Unverified reports suggest undefeated sensation Usman Nurmagomedov has signed with the UFC following his PFL exit, with a potential official announcement targeting UFC 334 fight week.
 From This Article 1 . Leaving Heavyweight Money to Pursue Legacy 
 Combat sports' biggest free agent might have officially found a new home. 
 Reports circulating across social media channels suggest that undefeated Dagestani star Usman Nurmagomedov has signed a deal with the UFC . As per unverified reports, the 28-year-old cousin of UFC Hall of Famer Khabib Nurmagomedov could be officially announced as the promotion's latest signing during the UFC 334 broadcast. 
 Whether the news is true or just rumors, we are yet to know.

 Leaving Heavyweight Money to Pursue Legacy
 These rumors come at a telling moment, with Nurmagomedov's contract status undergoing recent structural shifts.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by MMA Uncensored ™️ (@mmauncensored__) 
 Having wrapped up his PFL obligations with a brutal first-round knockout of Archie Colgan, Nurmagomedov became a free agent once his exclusive 90-day negotiating window officially closed. The Dagestani finish-master reportedly turned down a lucrative $2 million per fight extension from the PFL, making his desires clear- he wants to challenge himself against the UFC's elite lightweights. 
 Teammate and UFC star Islam Makhachev had previously put the odds of Nurmagomedov transitioning to the Octagon at 90 percent. This simply added to the speculation that a deal could just be around the corner. 
 A Mega Addition to the 155-Pound Shark Tank
 If UFC CEO Dana White confirms it, Nurmagomedov's arrival could end up sending shockwaves through the entire 155-pound landscape. 
 Undefeated at 22-0, Nurmagomedov strategically combined sharp striking, fluid wrestling mechanics, and dangerous submission skills. He enters the UFC with a pristine record and championship credentials, instantly becoming a title contender in the world's premier promotion. 
 While fight fans are eagerly awaiting an official announcement, the possibility of seeing Khabib Nurmagomedov back in a UFC corner to guide his undefeated cousin through his UFC debut has the entire MMA world buzzing.
